hypertensive-heart-disease: No case names hypertensive heart disease directly. Use the hypertension and heart failure cases listed as related cases. A hypertension follow-up visit with new signs of heart failure covers both.
prostate-cancer: Only one free case was found. The cancer disclosure and screening conversation cases under Other cancers can be adapted to a prostate cancer patient.
liver-cancer: Only published case reports were found, with no SP script. The hepatitis and cirrhosis cases listed as related cases cover the same patients earlier in their disease.
hepatitis: Only published case reports were found, with no SP script. Adapt one into an SP encounter about a positive hepatitis B test and follow-up.
breast-cancer: Few cases. Most are breaking bad news encounters. Screening and symptom cases are rare.
lung-cancer: Few cases. Most are breaking bad news or end-of-life encounters.
cervical-cancer: Few cases, and no SP case for screening with visual inspection (VIA). The WHO and IARC screening materials in Sources teach the method but give no patient script.
chronic-kidney-disease: Few cases. Most are acute problems, such as high potassium, in patients with kidney failure.
